name: travel-exam-planner
description: Plan door-to-door travel for exams and concursos, balancing total cost, time away, sleep, work impact, and disruption risk.

interface.shortDescription: Plan efficient, low-risk trips for exams
interface.longDescription: Build and compare door-to-door itineraries for in-person exams and concursos. The plugin combines calendar constraints, official exam facts, flights, buses, lodging, local transport, safety buffers, and total trip cost, then explains the best balance, lowest-cost, and shortest-absence options.
defaultPrompt: Planeje minha viagem para uma prova com o menor tempo fora de casa.
Compare voo, ônibus e hospedagem para meu próximo concurso.
Revise meu roteiro de prova e identifique riscos e custos ocultos.
